title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — September 24, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.5)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.1 (Peaked September 23, 2026 at 15:32 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 375 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Keeping watch. Nothing unusual. 👀☀️

A few modest active regions and small sunspot groups are visible, while the corona remains broadly quiet.

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
